title: PAC-MATES
oneLiner: Two players clear a shared maze, gobble dots, and outscore the roaming ghosts together.
mechanics: Player one is a yellow round maze-runner; player two is a blue round maze-runner, each moving tile-by-tile through the shared maze.
Collect every dot for 10 points and power pellets for 50 points; a pellet makes ghosts vulnerable for 6 seconds, with chained captures worth 200, 400, 800, then 1600.
Four ghosts patrol, chase, ambush, and briefly scatter; players can pass through each other, but a ghost collision costs a life unless powered.
The maze is compact and fully visible; each round gives an early pellet within 5 seconds, pressure rises through faster ghost movement, and a clear route remains available for recovery.

controls.left: Move left; buffer the turn until the next legal junction.
controls.right: Move right; buffer the turn until the next legal junction.
controls.up: Move up; buffer the turn until the next legal junction.
controls.down: Move down; buffer the turn until the next legal junction.
controls.a: Use a collected power pellet immediately to frighten ghosts for 6 seconds.
controls.b: Ping the shared maze route for 1 second, highlighting nearby dots and the safest open corridor; cooldown 4 seconds.

lose: The team loses a life when either player is caught by a normal ghost; the game ends after 3 shared lives, or when time expires with uncleared dots.
scoring: Score dots, pellets, and unique ghost captures; chained powered captures multiply up to 1600 points before the multiplier resets.
